title: Structure-Aware Transformers for Hierarchical Authorization in Personal AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.32018v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personal AI agents can carry out complex, multi-step tasks on users' behalf, but doing so often involves numerous permission requests. Manually reviewing each request is time-consuming, while indiscriminate approval poses privacy and security risks. Predicting users' authorization preferences offers a way to reduce this burden while preserving user control. However, authorization prediction is challenging because permission requests are often hierarchical and observed user decisions are sparse and potentially correlated. To address these challenges, We propose the Parent-gated Authorization Transformer for Hierarchies (PATH) to predict users' authorization preferences for personal AI agents. PATH is a novel neural network architecture that combines hierarchy-aware attention masks with a parent-gated probability formulation to ensure hierarchy-consistent predictions. translated_title: 面向个人AI智能体分层授权的结构感知Transformer
translated_abstract: 个人AI智能体可以代表用户执行复杂的多步骤任务，但这一过程通常涉及大量的权限请求。逐一手动审查这些请求非常耗时，而不加区分地全部批准则会带来隐私与安全风险。预测用户的授权偏好是一种既减轻负担又保留用户控制权的方式。然而，授权预测极具挑战性，因为权限请求往往呈层级结构，且观察到的用户决策稀疏且可能相互关联。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了分层父门控授权Transformer（PATH），用于预测用户对个人AI智能体的授权偏好。PATH是一种新颖的神经网络架构，它将层级感知的注意力掩码与父门控概率公式相结合，以确保预测结果与层级结构保持一致。层级嵌入进一步支持从稀疏观察中学习。
tldr: 提出PATH架构，通过层级感知注意力掩码与父门控概率机制，为个人AI智能体预测与权限层级结构一致的用户授权偏好，从而在保障隐私安全的同时减轻手动审查权限请求的负担。
en_tdlr: Proposes PATH, a structure-aware Transformer that combines hierarchy-aware attention masks with a parent-gated probability formulation to predict hierarchy-consistent user authorization preferences for personal AI agents, reducing the burden of manual permission review while preserving privacy and security.
